Then P(X=())=c(())=1, both receipt arms have probability 1/2, receipt mean equality holds and first stage is 1. Checked in scratch/Nonvacuity.lean.

Exact finite independence and all four relevant weighted arm differences were independently checked; every Wald denominator is positive.
